# GUNGATOUR

> We live in Oklahoma and we suck at golf.

GUNGATOUR is a celebration of bad golf played by enthusiastic Oklahomans. No pros. No birdies. Just a group of people from Oklahoma who love golf and are genuinely, consistently, historically terrible at it.

## What This Is

- A landing page for gungatour.com
- Built in OU colors (Crimson #841617 and Cream #FDF9F0)
- Home of the Gunga Tour — an informal golf tour among friends in Oklahoma

## The One Thing You Need to Know

tl;dr — we just suck at golf.

## Links
